title: PowerToys randomly exits
summary: The PowerToys Runner disappears while Command Palette remains active; an assigned maintainer shipped targeted session-end diagnostics and the reporter supplied two requested preview-build reports, with the latest comment only asking for an update.

judgment.rationale: The issue is actively owned by assignee moooyo. Merged PR #50273 added the requested Runner session-end diagnostics, preview build 0.101.2512.0 was supplied, and the reporter uploaded two post-failure reports from that build. The 2026-09-17 follow-up asks for status but adds no new evidence or unmet reporter-side request, so another dashboard request or competing design would duplicate the maintainer investigation.
evidence: The reporter observes the Runner/tray and PowerToys modules disappearing after hours of use while Command Palette remains active on multiple systems.
Maintainer moooyo is assigned and stated that the original report did not identify the exit reason.
PR #50273 merged on 2026-09-07 and added logging for WM_QUERYENDSESSION and WM_ENDSESSION in src/runner/tray_icon.cpp.
The maintainer directed the reporter to preview build 0.101.2512.0 for the next reproduction.
The reporter attached two new PowerToysReport ZIPs on 2026-09-11, then asked for an update on 2026-09-17.
judgment.recommended_action: Leave the issue with the assigned maintainer to interpret the already supplied preview-build reports; do not ask the reporter for duplicate diagnostics or start a competing fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: Merged PR #50273 is the concrete diagnostic implementation created for this investigation, and the requested post-instrumentation evidence is already attached for maintainer analysis.

issue_context.summary: An intermittent Runner exit remains under active maintainer investigation after targeted session-end logging was merged and exercised in a preview build.
known_information: The symptom has occurred on multiple systems during ordinary browsing and video use.
Updating from 0.100.2 did not eliminate the behavior.
The first report was generated after restarting PowerToys and did not expose the exit cause.
Maintainer moooyo is assigned and merged PR #50273 to add Runner session-end diagnostics.
The reporter supplied two reports after reproducing with preview build 0.101.2512.0.
The latest public activity is the reporter asking for an update on 2026-09-17.
inferences: The surviving Command Palette is consistent with a Runner-specific termination path, but the public discussion does not confirm which path occurred.
The next decision depends on maintainer interpretation of the already attached instrumented reports rather than more reporter evidence.
issue_context.analysis: The latest comment changes freshness but not the substantive triage state. The requested instrumentation and reporter retest are complete, ownership is explicit, and no public evidence supports a separate root-cause claim or another reporter request.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete issue body, all 15 comments, current labels, assignee, and timeline through 2026-09-17T13:40:01Z.
Confirmed PR #50273 is merged, closes the issue in its metadata, and changes src/runner/tray_icon.cpp only to add session-end diagnostics without altering behavior.
Confirmed the issue is currently open and assigned despite the earlier close event generated by the merged PR.

information_gaps.information: Maintainer interpretation of the session-end records in the two reports uploaded on 2026-09-11.
information_gaps.why_needed: Those records distinguish Windows session-end, Restart Manager close-app, a crash, or another Runner termination path.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: The assigned maintainer reviews the already attached reports; no additional reporter action is currently needed.
